vocabulary.definition: Used as a greeting
examples: Hello, how are you?
vocabulary.explanationFa: درودِ غیررسمی و روزمره؛ صبح‌ها Good morning و هنگام خداحافظی Goodbye می‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: Greeting used before noon
examples: Good morning, teacher!
vocabulary.explanationFa: تنها برای صبح تا حدود ظهر؛ بعد از آن Good afternoon یا Good evening می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Expression of gratitude
examples: Thank you for your help.
vocabulary.explanationFa: برای تشکر؛ با very much شدت می‌گیرد: Thank you very much.

vocabulary.definition: Used to make a request polite
examples: Please sit down.
vocabulary.explanationFa: واژهٔ ادب؛ در درخواست و پذیرش می‌آید: Yes, please.

vocabulary.definition: Said when leaving
examples: Goodbye, see you tomorrow.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خداحافظی؛ غیررسمی‌اش Bye و خداحافظی شبانه Good night است.

vocabulary.definition: Polite phrase when meeting someone first time
examples: Hi, I'm Sara. Nice to meet you.
vocabulary.explanationFa: عبارت ثابتِ نخستین آشنایی؛ پاسخش Nice to meet you too است.

vocabulary.definition: To stop sleeping
examples: I wake up at seven.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بیدار شدن از خواب؛ اگر خودت از رختخواب بیرون بیایی get up می‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: First meal of the day
examples: I eat breakfast with my family.
vocabulary.explanationFa: صبحانه؛ با have/make بیاید: have breakfast.

vocabulary.definition: Something you do most of the time
examples: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قید تکرار؛ پیش از فعل اصلی و پس از فعل to be: I usually walk.

vocabulary.definition: To wash your body
examples: I take a shower every morning.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دوش گرفتن؛ فعلش take یا have است، نه do: take a shower.

vocabulary.definition: To travel to your job
examples: I go to work by bus.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رفتن به سر کار؛ با go to + مکان ساخته می‌شود.

vocabulary.definition: The part of the day before night
examples: We watch TV in the evening.
vocabulary.explanationFa: عصر تا پیش از خواب؛ با in the evening می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A female parent
examples: My mother is a teacher.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مادر؛ غیررسمی‌اش mum (بریتانیا) یا mom (آمریکا) است.

vocabulary.definition: A male parent
examples: My father works at a bank.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پدر؛ غیررسمی‌اش dad است.

vocabulary.definition: A girl with the same parents as you
examples: I have one sister.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خواهر؛ با older/younger تفاوت سنی را می‌رساند.

vocabulary.definition: A boy with the same parents as you
examples: My brother is ten years old.
vocabulary.explanationFa: برادر؛ جمعش brothers است.

vocabulary.definition: Your male child
examples: They have one son.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پسرِ فرزند؛ با boy که پسر به‌طور کلی است فرق دارد.

vocabulary.definition: Your female child
examples: Her daughter studies English.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دخترِ فرزند؛ دقیق‌تر از girl است.

vocabulary.definition: Document for traveling abroad
examples: Please show me your passport.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گذرنامه؛ در فرودگاه با passport control می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Card that lets you enter the plane
examples: Here is my boarding pass.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کارت پرواز؛ پیش از سوار شدن به هواپیما نشان داده می‌شود.

vocabulary.definition: A journey by plane
examples: The flight to Dubai takes three hours.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پرواز؛ با flight number (شمارهٔ پرواز) می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The door where you board the plane
examples: Gate 12 is over there.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دروازهٔ سوار شدن به هواپیماست، نه درِ ورودی ساختمان.

vocabulary.definition: Bags you take when traveling
examples: I lost my luggage.
vocabulary.explanationFa: چمدان و بار؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس luggages نمی‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: The act of leaving a place
examples: Departure is at 9 p.m.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خروج و حرکت؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش arrival (ورود) است.

vocabulary.definition: List of food you can order
examples: Can I see the menu, please?
vocabulary.explanationFa: فهرست غذا؛ در رستوران برای انتخاب غذا به آن نگاه می‌کنی.

vocabulary.definition: A person who serves you in a restaurant
examples: The waiter brought the bill.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پیشخدمتِ مرد؛ برای زن waitress به کار می‌رود.

vocabulary.definition: To ask for food or drink
examples: I would like to order chicken.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سفارش دادن؛ با order food یعنی سفارش غذا دادن.

vocabulary.definition: Very pleasant to taste
examples: This soup is delicious.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خوشمزه؛ برای غذا و نوشیدنی، نه برای شخص.

vocabulary.definition: The paper that shows how much you must pay
examples: Can we have the bill, please?
vocabulary.explanationFa: صورت‌حساب؛ در آمریکا به آن check می‌گویند.

vocabulary.definition: Booking a table in advance
examples: I have a reservation for two.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رزرو میز؛ با make a reservation می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The amount of money something costs
examples: How much is this?
vocabulary.explanationFa: قیمت؛ با price tag (برچسب قیمت) هم می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Costing little money
examples: These shoes are very cheap.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ارزان؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش expensive است.

vocabulary.definition: Coins and notes used to buy things
examples: I don't have enough money.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پول؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس moneys نمی‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: To give money for goods or services
examples: Can I pay by card?
vocabulary.explanationFa: پرداخت کردن؛ با pay for + چیز می‌آید: pay for the ticket.

vocabulary.definition: A reduction in the usual price
examples: Everything is twenty percent off today.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تخفیف؛ با get a discount می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams
examples: I need a kilo of apples.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کیلوگرم؛ با a kilo of می‌آید: a kilo of apples.

vocabulary.definition: Moving forward without turning
examples: Go straight ahead.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مستقیم؛ go straight ahead عبارت ثابتِ «جلوی مستقیم برو» است.

vocabulary.definition: The point where two streets or walls meet
examples: The bank is on the corner.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گوشه و چهارراه؛ on the corner یعنی سرِ نبش.

vocabulary.definition: Signals that control traffic at crossings
examples: Turn right at the second traffic light.
vocabulary.explanationFa: چراغ راهنما؛ با at the traffic light می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: On the other side of a space from something
examples: The bus stop is opposite the bank.
vocabulary.explanationFa: روبرو؛ با across from هم‌معنی است.

vocabulary.definition: The distance between two crossings in a city
examples: It's two blocks from here.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بلوک شهری، فاصلهٔ میان دو چهارراه؛ one block away.

vocabulary.definition: A place where two roads cross
examples: Wait at the intersection.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تقاطع؛ رسمی‌تر از crossroads است.

vocabulary.definition: Pain in the head
examples: I have a terrible headache.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سردرد؛ با have a headache می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A substance taken to treat illness
examples: Take your medicine after meals.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دارو؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس medicines نمی‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: A high body temperature when ill
examples: The child has a fever.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تب؛ با have a fever می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A written order for medicine from a doctor
examples: You need a prescription for this.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نسخهٔ پزشک؛ با write یا fill a prescription.

vocabulary.definition: To get better after an illness
examples: It took a week to recover.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بهبود یافتن؛ با recover from + بیماری می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: An unpleasant feeling in the body
examples: There is pain in my back.
vocabulary.explanationFa: درد؛ با in pain یعنی «در درد» می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A person's professional life over many years
examples: She built a career in engineering.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مسیر شغلی درازمدت؛ با job که شغل فعلی است فرق دارد.

vocabulary.definition: The latest time something must be finished
examples: We have to meet the deadline.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مهلت؛ با meet a deadline و miss a deadline می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A person you work with
examples: My colleagues are very helpful.
vocabulary.explanationFa: همکار؛ رابطهٔ حرفه‌ای را می‌رساند.

vocabulary.definition: To make a formal request for a job or course
examples: I applied for the position last week.
vocabulary.explanationFa: درخواست دادن؛ با apply for + شغل می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Regular payment for a job
examples: The salary is paid monthly.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حقوق ثابت ماهانه؛ wage دستمزد ساعتی است.

vocabulary.definition: A skill or certificate that makes you suitable for a job
examples: You need the right qualifications for this role.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مدرک و صلاحیت تحصیلی یا حرفه‌ای.

vocabulary.definition: The title of a news story
examples: The story made headlines worldwide.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تیتر اصلی خبر؛ با make headlines (شاخص شدن) هم می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A written or spoken account of an event
examples: The report was published this morning.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گزارش؛ هم اسم است و هم فعل.

vocabulary.definition: A place something comes from or is obtained from
examples: The newspaper cited an anonymous source.
vocabulary.explanationFa: منبع خبر؛ با reliable source می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To make something known publicly
examples: The company announced a new product.
vocabulary.explanationFa: اعلام کردنِ رسمی؛ با announce a decision.

vocabulary.definition: A person who writes for newspapers or news sites
examples: The journalist interviewed the mayor.
vocabulary.explanationFa: روزنامه‌نگار؛ با reporter هم‌معنی است.

vocabulary.definition: To send out a programme or news on TV or radio
examples: The match is broadcast live.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پخش کردن برنامه؛ هم اسم و هم فعل است.

vocabulary.definition: To choose after thinking about options
examples: We decided to travel by train.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تصمیم گرفتن؛ با decide on/about + اسم می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To plan or aim to do something
examples: I intend to finish by Friday.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قصد داشتن؛ با intend to + فعل ساده می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A plan of when things will happen
examples: The train is on schedule.
vocabulary.explanationFa: برنامهٔ زمانی؛ behind schedule یعنی عقب از برنامه.

vocabulary.definition: To have enough money for something
examples: We can't afford a new car.
vocabulary.explanationFa: توان مالی داشتن؛ با can/can't afford to + فعل می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Almost certainly but not definitely
examples: It will probably rain tomorrow.
vocabulary.explanationFa: به احتمال زیاد؛ پیش از فعل اصلی می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: One of the choices available
examples: We have two options: bus or train.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گزینه؛ با keep your options open هم می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The act of travelling from one place to another
examples: The journey took six hours.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سفرِ طولانی و مسیر؛ سفر کوتاه trip است.

vocabulary.definition: Worth remembering
examples: It was a memorable trip.
vocabulary.explanationFa: به‌یادماندنی؛ از ریشهٔ memory ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: Something bought to remind you of a place
examples: I bought a souvenir from the old town.
vocabulary.explanationFa: یادگاری سفر؛ با bring back souvenirs می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To travel through a place to learn about it
examples: We explored the old city on foot.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کاوش کردن؛ برای مکان و ایده هر دو به کار می‌رود.

vocabulary.definition: An unusual, exciting experience
examples: Hiking in the mountains was a real adventure.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ماجراجویی؛ با go on an adventure می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: In or to a foreign country
examples: She studied abroad for a year.
vocabulary.explanationFa: در خارج از کشور؛ قید است و با in/to به کار نمی‌رود.

vocabulary.definition: A new idea, method or product
examples: Digital innovation has changed banking.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نوآوری؛ از فعل innovate ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: No longer used because something newer exists
examples: Old phones become obsolete quickly.
vocabulary.explanationFa: منسوخ؛ با become obsolete می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The freedom to keep your personal life private
examples: The app raises serious privacy concerns.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حریم خصوصی؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است.

vocabulary.definition: A set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
examples: The algorithm recommends videos.
vocabulary.explanationFa: الگوریتم؛ مجموعه‌ای از دستورهای محاسباتی برای حل یک مسئله.

vocabulary.definition: A piece of equipment made for a purpose
examples: The device was invented last year.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دستگاه و ابزار الکترونیکی؛ با mobile device.

vocabulary.definition: Made by humans rather than occurring in nature
examples: Artificial intelligence is everywhere now.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مصنوعی؛ مقابل natural و با artificial intelligence.

vocabulary.definition: Damage to air, water or land caused by harmful substances
examples: Air pollution is a major health risk.
vocabulary.explanationFa: آلودگی؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس pollutions نمی‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: Able to continue without exhausting resources
examples: We need sustainable energy sources.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پایدار؛ sustainable development یعنی توسعهٔ پایدار.

vocabulary.definition: Gas or radiation released into the air
examples: The country pledged to cut carbon emissions.
vocabulary.explanationFa: انتشار آلاینده؛ معمولاً جمع می‌آید: carbon emissions.

vocabulary.definition: To protect something from waste or destruction
examples: We must conserve water during the drought.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حفاظت و صرفه‌جویی کردن؛ با conserve energy.

vocabulary.definition: A danger or risk
examples: Flooding is a hazard in this region.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خطر و عامل زیان‌آور؛ با health hazard.

vocabulary.definition: A resource that is not used up, like solar power
examples: Renewable energy is growing fast.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تجدیدپذیر؛ با renewable energy.

vocabulary.definition: A person who applies for a job or takes a test
examples: Twenty candidates applied for the role.
vocabulary.explanationFa: داوطلب و کاندیدا؛ با candidate for + جایگاه می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A quality or ability you are good at
examples: Teamwork is my greatest strength.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نقطهٔ قوت؛ جمعش strengths در مصاحبهٔ کاری رایج است.

vocabulary.definition: Knowledge or skill gained from doing something
examples: She has ten years of experience.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تجربه؛ در معنای تجربهٔ کاری غیرقابل‌شمارش است.

vocabulary.definition: Something important you succeed in doing
examples: Getting the degree was a real achievement.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دستاورد؛ از فعل achieve ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: Having a duty to deal with something
examples: I was responsible for training new staff.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مسئول؛ با responsible for + کار می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Having the right qualities for something
examples: Only experienced candidates are eligible.
vocabulary.explanationFa: واجد شرایط؛ با eligible for می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The business of promoting products to the public
examples: Advertising influences what we buy.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تبلیغات به‌عنوان صنعت؛ یک آگهیِ مشخص advertisement است.

vocabulary.definition: The people who watch or listen to something
examples: The show has a huge audience.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مخاطبان؛ گروهی که محتوا را می‌بینند یا می‌شنوند.

vocabulary.definition: An organized series of activities to reach a goal
examples: The advertising campaign was a success.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کمپین؛ با launch a campaign می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: An unfair preference for or against something
examples: Readers accused the paper of bias.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سوگیری؛ با political bias.

vocabulary.definition: A short phrase used in advertising or campaigns
examples: The brand's slogan is now famous.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شعار تبلیغاتی؛ جمله‌ای کوتاه و به‌یادماندنی.

vocabulary.definition: To affect how someone thinks or acts
examples: Social media influences young voters.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تأثیر گذاشتن؛ هم فعل است و هم اسم.

vocabulary.definition: A proposed explanation to be tested
examples: The data support our hypothesis.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فرضیه؛ با test a hypothesis می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The system of methods used in a study
examples: The paper explains its methodology in detail.
vocabulary.explanationFa: روش‌شناسی؛ نظام روش‌های یک پژوهش.

vocabulary.definition: Facts that show something is true
examples: There is little evidence for the claim.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شواهد؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس evidences نمی‌گوییم.

vocabulary.definition: To quote a source as evidence
examples: The study cites earlier research.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ارجاع دادن؛ با cite a source می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A system of signs or symbols used in a subject
examples: The equation uses standard notation.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نمادگذاری قراردادی؛ مانند mathematical notation.

vocabulary.definition: Large in amount, value or importance
examples: The study received substantial funding.
vocabulary.explanationFa: چشمگیر و قابل توجه؛ با substantial evidence.

vocabulary.definition: An argument against the opposite view
examples: She anticipated every counterargument.
vocabulary.explanationFa: استدلال متقابل؛ پاسخ به استدلال مخالف.

vocabulary.definition: Good at making people believe or do something
examples: He made a persuasive case for reform.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قانع‌کننده؛ از فعل persuade ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: A point someone argues for, or heated disagreement
examples: His main contention is that costs will rise.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ادعای اصلی؛ با central contention می‌آید.

vocabulary.translation: تضعیف کردن، پایه‌ها را سست کردن
vocabulary.definition: To make something weaker gradually
examples: The scandal undermined public trust.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تضعیف کردن؛ با undermine confidence.

vocabulary.definition: To admit something is true after resisting it
examples: He had to concede that she was right.
vocabulary.explanationFa: به‌ناچار پذیرفتن؛ با concede a point می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The art of effective speaking or writing
examples: Behind the rhetoric there were few facts.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بلاغت و سخنوری؛ گاه بار منفی دارد: empty rhetoric.

vocabulary.definition: Relating to films, or having the quality of a film
examples: The film has a cinematic feel.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سینمایی؛ کیفیتی که یادآور فیلم است.

vocabulary.definition: Translated text shown at the bottom of a film
examples: I watched it with English subtitles.
vocabulary.explanationFa: زیرنویس؛ معمولاً جمع می‌آید: subtitles.

vocabulary.definition: The way someone or something is represented
examples: The film's portrayal of war is realistic.
vocabulary.explanationFa: به تصویر کشیدن؛ از فعل portray ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: A fixed and oversimplified idea about a group
examples: The characters avoid every stereotype.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کلیشه؛ با break a stereotype می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The person who directs a film or play
examples: The director won an award for this film.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کارگردان؛ با film director.

vocabulary.definition: A story or account of events
examples: The film follows a non-linear narrative.
vocabulary.explanationFa: روایت؛ ساختار داستان‌گویی.

vocabulary.definition: To stop trying or quit a habit
examples: She gave up smoking last year.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دست کشیدن؛ با give up on + شخص یا چیز می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To delay something
examples: They put the meeting off until Friday.
vocabulary.explanationFa: به تعویق انداختن؛ با put off until.

vocabulary.definition: To find or meet by chance
examples: I came across an old photo yesterday.
vocabulary.explanationFa: اتفاقی پیدا کردن؛ با come across as یعنی «به نظر رسیدن».

vocabulary.definition: To do something wrong without being punished
examples: He thought he could get away with lying.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بی‌مجازات ماندن؛ با get away with it.

vocabulary.definition: To use up all of something
examples: We ran out of milk this morning.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تمام شدن موجودی؛ با run out of time.

vocabulary.definition: To mention or start talking about a subject
examples: Don't bring up politics at dinner.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پیش کشیدن موضوع؛ با bring up a topic.

vocabulary.definition: Open to more than one interpretation
examples: Her reply was deliberately ambiguous.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مبهم و دوپهلو؛ از آن دو معنا برداشت می‌شود.

vocabulary.definition: Not obvious and needing attention to notice
examples: There is a subtle difference between the two words.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ظریف و پنهان؛ با subtle difference.

vocabulary.definition: An idea suggested by a word beyond its literal meaning
examples: The word carries a negative connotation.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بار معنایی ضمنی؛ می‌تواند مثبت یا منفی باشد.

vocabulary.definition: Not clearly expressed or detailed
examples: The instructions were frustratingly vague.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مبهم و نامشخص؛ اغلب بار منفی دارد.

vocabulary.definition: A difference between similar things
examples: The distinction between the two proposals is significant.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تمایز؛ با draw a distinction می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To suggest something without saying it directly
examples: The report implies that costs will rise.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تلویحاً بیان کردن؛ گوینده imply می‌کند و شنونده infer.

vocabulary.definition: Fluent and persuasive speaking or writing
examples: He impressed the jury with his eloquence.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فصاحت و بلاغت؛ از صفت eloquent ساخته شده است.

vocabulary.definition: To prove a statement or theory wrong
examples: Nobody could refute her logic.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رد کردن با دلیل؛ قوی‌تر از deny است.

vocabulary.definition: Brevity; saying much in few words
examples: The essay is praised for its concision.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ایجاز؛ کوتاه‌گویی همراه با روشنی.

vocabulary.definition: Saying the opposite of what you mean, or an unexpected outcome
examples: The irony of the ending escaped him.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کنایه؛ تضاد میان ظاهر و معنای واقعی.

vocabulary.definition: The rude feeling that you are better than others
examples: His arrogance annoyed the whole team.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تکبر؛ صفتش arrogant است.

vocabulary.definition: To make someone do something through reasoning
examples: She persuaded the committee to change its vote.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قانع کردن؛ با persuade somebody to do.

vocabulary.definition: Based on observation or experiment rather than theory
examples: The claim lacks empirical support.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تجربی؛ مبتنی بر مشاهده و آزمایش، نه نظریهٔ محض.

vocabulary.definition: To confirm a statement with other evidence
examples: The results corroborate the initial hypothesis.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تأیید کردن با شواهد مستقل.

vocabulary.definition: Thinking about something without knowing the facts
examples: There has been much speculation about the cause.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حدس و گمان؛ با pure speculation.

vocabulary.definition: A factor that can change in an experiment
examples: Temperature was the only variable.
vocabulary.explanationFa: متغیر؛ در پژوهش چیزی که تغییر می‌کند.

vocabulary.definition: Exact and accurate
examples: Give a precise measurement, please.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دقیق؛ با precise wording.

vocabulary.definition: An observable event or fact
examples: Northern lights are a natural phenomenon.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پدیده؛ جمعش phenomena است.

vocabulary.definition: The person who tells the story
examples: The narrator is unreliable.
vocabulary.explanationFa: راوی داستان؛ با unreliable narrator.

vocabulary.definition: The main character of a story
examples: The protagonist fails in the final chapter.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قهرمان اصلی؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش antagonist است.

vocabulary.definition: A story with a hidden moral or political meaning
examples: Critics saw the ending as an allegory of failure.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تمثیل؛ داستانی با معنای نمادینِ زیرین.

vocabulary.definition: Hints in a story of what will happen later
examples: The storm is foreshadowing the hero's fall.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پیش‌درآمد؛ نشانه‌ای از رویداد آیندهٔ داستان.

vocabulary.definition: Visually descriptive language in literature
examples: The poem's imagery is vivid.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تصویرسازی زبانی؛ با vivid imagery.

vocabulary.definition: A comparison of unlike things without like or as
examples: Life is a journey is a common metaphor.
vocabulary.explanationFa: استعاره؛ با extended metaphor.

vocabulary.definition: What a person or thing is called
examples: My name is Sara.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نام؛ با first name و full name می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A person you like and know well
examples: This is my friend Ali.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دوست؛ با make friends یعنی «دوست پیدا کردن».

vocabulary.definition: To see and speak to someone for the first time or again
examples: Nice to meet you.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ملاقات کردن؛ با meet for the first time.

vocabulary.definition: Not existing or known before
examples: She is my new colleague.
vocabulary.explanationFa: جدید؛ با brand new یعنی «کاملاً نو».

vocabulary.definition: To do a job, especially to earn money
examples: I work in a hospital.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کار کردن؛ با work as + شغل می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To have your home in a place
examples: I live in Tehran.
vocabulary.explanationFa: زندگی کردن؛ با live in + مکان می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Water that falls from clouds
examples: The rain stopped in the afternoon.
vocabulary.explanationFa: باران؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، با heavy rain می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: With a lot of bright light from the sun
examples: It is sunny today.
vocabulary.explanationFa: آفتابی؛ با a sunny day می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A white or grey mass in the sky made of water drops
examples: There are dark clouds over the city.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ابر؛ صفتش cloudy (ابری) است.

vocabulary.definition: Air that moves quickly outside
examples: The wind is strong today.
vocabulary.explanationFa: باد؛ با strong wind می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: One of the four parts of the year
examples: Spring is my favourite season.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فصل سال؛ با the rainy season هم می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: A little hot, in a pleasant way
examples: It is warm in April.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گرم و مطبوع؛ گرمای شدید hot است.

vocabulary.definition: An activity you enjoy doing in your free time
examples: Photography is my main hobby.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سرگرمی؛ با take up a hobby می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To bring things together and keep them
examples: He collects old coins.
vocabulary.explanationFa: جمع‌آوری کردن؛ با collect stamps.

vocabulary.definition: The activity or result of making pictures with paint
examples: She spends Sundays painting.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نقاشی؛ هم به فعالیت و هم به اثر گفته می‌شود.

vocabulary.definition: The art of taking photographs
examples: I took a photography class last year.
vocabulary.explanationFa: عکاسی؛ با take up photography.

vocabulary.definition: A person who belongs to a group or club
examples: I am a member of a chess club.
vocabulary.explanationFa: عضو؛ با become a member.

vocabulary.definition: Time when you are not working or studying
examples: What do you do in your spare time?
vocabulary.explanationFa: وقت آزاد؛ با in my spare time می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: The area of a town where people live
examples: Our neighbourhood is very quiet.
vocabulary.explanationFa: محله؛ با quiet neighbourhood.

vocabulary.definition: Full of people
examples: The market is crowded on Fridays.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شلوغ؛ با crowded street.

vocabulary.definition: The cars and other vehicles moving on a road
examples: There is heavy traffic in the morning.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ترافیک؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است، با heavy traffic.

vocabulary.definition: Easy and useful, without causing problems
examples: The flat is convenient for the station.
vocabulary.explanationFa: راحت و در دسترس؛ با convenient for.

vocabulary.definition: An open public area with grass and trees
examples: We walk in the park every evening.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پارک؛ با public park.

vocabulary.definition: An underground railway system in a city
examples: I take the subway to work.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مترو؛ در بریتانیا underground یا tube می‌گویند.

vocabulary.definition: A plan for how much money you can spend
examples: We set a monthly budget for food.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بودجه؛ با stick to a budget.

vocabulary.definition: To keep money for later instead of spending it
examples: I save a small amount every month.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پس‌انداز کردن؛ با save up for می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Money that you have to spend on something
examples: Rent is our biggest expense.
vocabulary.explanationFa: هزینه؛ معمولاً جمع می‌آید: living expenses.

vocabulary.definition: To have enough money for something
examples: We cannot afford a new car this year.
vocabulary.explanationFa: توان مالی داشتن؛ با can't afford.

vocabulary.definition: Money that you owe to someone
examples: He is working hard to pay off his debt.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بدهی؛ با pay off a debt.

vocabulary.definition: The money you receive from work or investments
examples: Her income increased after the promotion.
vocabulary.explanationFa: درآمد؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش expense (هزینه) است.

vocabulary.definition: Food that contains the right amounts of everything you need
examples: A balanced diet includes fruit and vegetables.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رژیم غذایی متعادل؛ با eat a balanced diet.

vocabulary.definition: Physical activity that keeps you healthy
examples: Regular exercise reduces stress.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ورزش؛ هم اسم است و هم فعل.

vocabulary.definition: Worry caused by a difficult situation
examples: Too much stress affects your sleep.
vocabulary.explanationFa: استرس؛ با reduce stress.

vocabulary.definition: The rest your body takes at night with your eyes closed
examples: Most adults need eight hours of sleep.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خواب؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش، با get enough sleep.

vocabulary.definition: Something you do often, almost without thinking
examples: Reading before bed is a good habit.
vocabulary.explanationFa: عادت؛ با break/form a habit می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To not do something you usually do
examples: Never skip breakfast before an exam.
vocabulary.explanationFa: جا انداختن؛ با skip a meal.

vocabulary.definition: A statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
examples: We received a complaint about the delay.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شکایت؛ با make a complaint.

vocabulary.definition: Money returned to you when you are not satisfied
examples: The shop offered a full refund.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بازپرداخت پول؛ با ask for a refund.

vocabulary.definition: To find an answer to a problem or disagreement
examples: The issue was resolved within two days.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حل کردن مشکل؛ با resolve an issue.

vocabulary.definition: The time by which something must be finished
examples: We are working to a tight deadline.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مهلت؛ با meet a deadline.

vocabulary.definition: A situation in which something happens later than planned
examples: There was a two-hour delay at the airport.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تأخیر؛ با without delay می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: To pay or give something for a loss or damage
examples: The airline agreed to compensate the passengers.
vocabulary.explanationFa: جبران کردن؛ با compensate for.

vocabulary.definition: Facts or signs that show something is true
examples: There is little evidence for this claim.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شواهد؛ غیرقابل‌شمارش است و s نمی‌گیرد.

vocabulary.definition: An idea suggested as an explanation, not yet proved
examples: The data support the original hypothesis.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فرضیه؛ با test یا reject a hypothesis.

vocabulary.definition: A small group taken from a larger group for testing
examples: The sample was too small to be reliable.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نمونه؛ با sample size.

vocabulary.definition: To show that something is likely to be true
examples: The results indicate a clear trend.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نشان دادن؛ با results indicate.

vocabulary.definition: Able to be trusted to be correct
examples: We need more reliable data.
vocabulary.explanationFa: قابل‌اعتماد؛ با reliable source.

vocabulary.definition: An unfair preference that affects judgement
examples: The study was criticised for its bias.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سوگیری؛ با avoid bias.

vocabulary.definition: To suggest something without saying it directly
examples: His silence implied agreement.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تلویحاً رساندن؛ گوینده imply می‌کند.

vocabulary.definition: To reach an opinion from the available evidence
examples: From her tone we inferred that she disagreed.
vocabulary.explanationFa: استنباط کردن؛ شنونده infer می‌کند.

vocabulary.definition: Something you accept as true without proof
examples: The argument rests on a questionable assumption.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فرض و پیش‌فرض؛ با make an assumption.

vocabulary.definition: The state of having more than one possible meaning
examples: The wording leaves room for ambiguity.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ابهام؛ با remove ambiguity.

vocabulary.translation: اغراق کردن، بیش از حد بزرگ‌نمایی کردن
vocabulary.definition: To describe something as more important than it is
examples: It is hard to overstate the impact of the reform.
vocabulary.explanationFa: اغراق کردن؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش understate است.

vocabulary.definition: Understood without being said aloud
examples: There was an unspoken agreement between them.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ناگفته؛ با unspoken rule.

vocabulary.definition: The level of formality of language used in a situation
examples: The letter uses a formal register throughout.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سبک زبانی؛ میزان رسمی‌بودن متناسب با موقعیت.

vocabulary.definition: Following official or serious conventions of language
examples: We would be grateful for a formal reply.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رسمی؛ نقطهٔ مقابلش informal و colloquial است.

vocabulary.definition: Used in ordinary conversation rather than formal writing
examples: The dialogue is full of colloquial expressions.
vocabulary.explanationFa: محاوره‌ای؛ مناسب گفتار غیررسمی.

vocabulary.definition: Turning a verb or adjective into a noun
examples: Academic writing relies heavily on nominalisation.
vocabulary.explanationFa: اسم‌سازی؛ تبدیل فعل به اسم مانند decide → decision.

vocabulary.definition: To soften a statement so it sounds less definite
examples: Writers hedge their claims with may and tends to.
vocabulary.explanationFa: تلطیف کردن ادعا؛ با may و tends to.

vocabulary.definition: Polite behaviour showing respect for others
examples: She had the courtesy to reply on the same day.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ادب و نزاکت؛ با common courtesy.

vocabulary.definition: The way parts of a text connect and hold together
examples: Good cohesion makes an essay easy to follow.
vocabulary.explanationFa: انسجام متن؛ پیوند میان جمله‌ها.

vocabulary.definition: A word or phrase that signals how ideas are related
examples: However and therefore are common discourse markers.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نشانگر گفتمانی؛ رابطهٔ میان ایده‌ها را نشان می‌دهد.

vocabulary.definition: The word that a pronoun or referring expression points back to
examples: The pronoun has no clear antecedent in this paragraph.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مرجع پیشین؛ اسمی که ضمیر به آن برمی‌گردد.

vocabulary.definition: Leaving out words that the reader can supply from context
examples: Ellipsis keeps the dialogue natural and fast.
vocabulary.explanationFa: حذف واژه‌های تکراری که خواننده می‌تواند تأمین کند.

vocabulary.definition: To express someone else's meaning in your own words
examples: You must paraphrase the source rather than copy it.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بازگویی؛ همان معنا با کلمات خودت.

vocabulary.definition: A change from one idea, section or state to another
examples: The transition between the two sections feels abrupt.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گذار میان بخش‌های متن.

vocabulary.definition: A mistaken belief or a fault in reasoning
examples: Attacking the speaker is a classic fallacy.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مغالطه؛ خطای استدلالی که نتیجه را بی‌اعتبار می‌کند.

vocabulary.definition: To admit that something is true before arguing against it
examples: She conceded the point and moved on to the main issue.
vocabulary.explanationFa: امتیاز دادن در بحث؛ پذیرفتن جزئی از حرف مخالف.

vocabulary.definition: To prove that a statement or theory is wrong
examples: The data refute the earlier explanation.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رد کردن با دلیل.

vocabulary.definition: A statement that an argument is based on
examples: The conclusion does not follow from the premises.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مقدمهٔ منطقی؛ پایه‌ای که نتیجه بر آن سوار است.

vocabulary.definition: A confident statement made without proof
examples: The essay offers assertion where it needs evidence.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ادعا؛ گزاره‌ای که هنوز اثبات نشده است.

vocabulary.definition: Attacking a weaker version of an opponent's argument
examples: That is a straw man; nobody proposed such a policy.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مغالطهٔ آدم‌کاهی؛ حمله به نسخهٔ ضعیف‌شدهٔ حرف مخالف.

vocabulary.definition: A combination of words that habitually occur together
examples: Make a decision is a strong collocation; do a decision is not.
vocabulary.explanationFa: هم‌نشینی واژه‌ها؛ ترکیب طبیعی که natives به کار می‌برند.

vocabulary.definition: To regularly appear together with another word
examples: Heavily collocates with rain and with criticism.
vocabulary.explanationFa: هم‌نشین شدن؛ با collocate with.

vocabulary.definition: A verb whose meaning comes mostly from the noun after it
examples: Have, take and make are common delexical verbs.
vocabulary.explanationFa: فعل سبک؛ معنای اصلی در اسم است، مانند take a shower.

vocabulary.definition: Related to the words of a language rather than its grammar
examples: The essay shows impressive lexical range.
vocabulary.explanationFa: واژگانی؛ مربوط به واژه‌ها و گنجینهٔ واژگان.

vocabulary.definition: Sound like a native speaker's natural word choices
examples: Her English is fluent and highly idiomatic.
vocabulary.explanationFa: اصطلاحی و طبیعی؛ با idiomatic English.

vocabulary.definition: The quality of being exact and clearly expressed
examples: The report is written with precision.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دقت؛ با with precision.

vocabulary.definition: Saying something is smaller or less important than it really is
examples: Calling the storm a little rain is a fine understatement.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کم‌گویی؛ کوچک‌نمایی عامدانه برای تأکید.

vocabulary.definition: Expressing a positive idea by denying its opposite
examples: Not uncommon is a typical litotes for fairly common.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کم‌گویی با نفیِ نقیض، مانند not uncommon.

vocabulary.definition: Showing no emotion while saying something funny or ironic
examples: He delivered the joke in a deadpan voice.
vocabulary.explanationFa: با چهرهٔ بی‌احساس؛ طنزِ خشک.

vocabulary.definition: A meaning that is implied rather than stated
examples: The subtext of the scene is that he already knows.
vocabulary.explanationFa: معنای پنهانِ زیر متن.

vocabulary.definition: Making yourself seem modest by joking about your weaknesses
examples: Her self-deprecating humour put everyone at ease.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خودکوچک‌کننده؛ طنز به خود.

vocabulary.definition: Trying to be funny about a serious matter
examples: The remark was facetious and badly timed.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شوخ‌طبع اما نامناسبِ موقعیت.

vocabulary.definition: A folding frame used for protection against rain
examples: It's raining — take an umbrella.
vocabulary.explanationFa: چتر؛ با take an umbrella.

vocabulary.definition: A round firm fruit with red, green or yellow skin
examples: She eats an apple every day.
vocabulary.explanationFa: سیب؛ با apple juice.

vocabulary.definition: A round citrus fruit with a thick orange skin
examples: I'd like an orange, please.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پرتقال؛ با orange juice.

vocabulary.definition: A period of sixty minutes
examples: The journey takes an hour.
vocabulary.explanationFa: ساعت (۶۰ دقیقه)؛ h در تلفظ خوانده نمی‌شود، پس an hour.

vocabulary.definition: The star that gives the Earth light and heat
examples: The sun rises in the east.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خورشید؛ یکتاست، پس با the می‌آید: the sun.

vocabulary.definition: A building where travellers pay to stay
examples: We stayed at a hotel by the sea.
vocabulary.explanationFa: هتل؛ با book a hotel.

vocabulary.definition: A young human who is not yet an adult — plural: children
examples: There are twenty children in the class.
vocabulary.explanationFa: کودک؛ جمعش بی‌قاعده است: children.

vocabulary.definition: An adult male person — plural: men
examples: The man is waiting outside.
vocabulary.explanationFa: مرد؛ جمعش بی‌قاعده است: men.

vocabulary.definition: An adult female person — plural: women
examples: Two women work in this office.
vocabulary.explanationFa: زن؛ جمعش بی‌قاعده است: women.

vocabulary.definition: The part of the body at the end of the leg — plural: feet
examples: My left foot hurts.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پا؛ جمعش بی‌قاعده است: feet.

vocabulary.definition: The flat green part of a plant — plural: leaves
examples: A dry leaf fell from the tree.
vocabulary.explanationFa: برگ؛ جمعش با تغییر f به v ساخته می‌شود: leaves.

vocabulary.definition: A container with straight sides and a lid
examples: Put the books in a box.
vocabulary.explanationFa: جعبه؛ جمعش با es ساخته می‌شود: boxes.

vocabulary.definition: A person you know well and like
examples: My friend lives in Tehran.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دوست؛ با make friends یعنی «دوست پیدا کردن».

vocabulary.definition: A person whose job is to teach
examples: Our teacher speaks English slowly.
vocabulary.explanationFa: معلم؛ با English teacher.

vocabulary.definition: A girl or woman who has the same parents as you
examples: Her sister works at a hospital.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خواهر؛ با younger sister.

vocabulary.definition: A boy or man who has the same parents as you
examples: He helps his brother with homework.
vocabulary.explanationFa: برادر؛ با twin brother.

vocabulary.definition: A person trained to treat ill people
examples: The doctor examined the patient.
vocabulary.explanationFa: پزشک؛ با see a doctor.

vocabulary.definition: A person who is studying at a school or university
examples: The teacher helped the students.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دانش‌آموز یا دانشجو؛ با exchange student.

vocabulary.definition: To move through water using your body
examples: I can swim but I can't dive.
vocabulary.explanationFa: شنا کردن؛ با go swimming.

vocabulary.definition: To control and move a car
examples: She can drive a car.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رانندگی کردن؛ با drive a car.

vocabulary.definition: To say words using your voice
examples: He can speak three languages.
vocabulary.explanationFa: صحبت کردن؛ با speak English.

vocabulary.definition: To prepare food with heat
examples: My father can cook very well.
vocabulary.explanationFa: آشپزی کردن؛ هم اسم (آشپز) و هم فعل.

vocabulary.definition: To take part in a game or to make music
examples: Can you play the guitar?
vocabulary.explanationFa: بازی کردن یا نواختن ساز؛ با play the piano.

vocabulary.definition: To move fast on foot
examples: She can run five kilometres.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دویدن؛ با go for a run.

vocabulary.definition: To finish moving or doing something
examples: Stop! The light is red.
vocabulary.explanationFa: توقف کردن؛ هم فعل است و هم اسم (ایستگاه).

vocabulary.definition: To stay somewhere until something happens
examples: Wait for me at the gate.
vocabulary.explanationFa: منتظر ماندن؛ با wait a moment.

vocabulary.definition: To rest with your weight on your bottom
examples: Please sit down.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نشستن؛ با sit down.

vocabulary.definition: To move something so it is no longer closed
examples: Open your books, please.
vocabulary.explanationFa: باز کردن؛ با open the door.

vocabulary.definition: To move something so that there is no opening
examples: Close the window, please.
vocabulary.explanationFa: بستن؛ با close your eyes.

vocabulary.definition: To give your attention to a sound
examples: Listen to the instructions carefully.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گوش دادن؛ با listen to + چیز می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about a thing or fact
examples: What is your name?
vocabulary.explanationFa: چه و چه‌چیز؛ با what time و what kind of.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about a place
examples: Where do you live?
vocabulary.explanationFa: کجا؛ با where from.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about a time
examples: When does the class start?
vocabulary.explanationFa: کی و چه‌وقت؛ با since when.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about a reason
examples: Why are you late?
vocabulary.explanationFa: چرا؛ پاسخش با because می‌آید.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about a person
examples: Who is that woman?
vocabulary.explanationFa: چه کسی؛ برای پرسش از فاعل به کار می‌رود.

vocabulary.definition: Used to ask about manner or degree
examples: How do you pronounce this?
vocabulary.explanationFa: چگونه؛ با how about و how come.

vocabulary.definition: Movement verb — past form: went
examples: We went to the coast last weekend.
vocabulary.explanationFa: رفتن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: went.

vocabulary.definition: To get something by paying for it — past form: bought
examples: She bought a new phone yesterday.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خریدن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: bought.

vocabulary.definition: To notice something with your eyes — past form: saw
examples: I saw an old friend at the market.
vocabulary.explanationFa: دیدن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: saw.

vocabulary.definition: To take food into your mouth — past form: ate
examples: We ate at a small restaurant.
vocabulary.explanationFa: خوردن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: ate.

vocabulary.definition: To move something with you — past form: took
examples: The train took two hours.
vocabulary.explanationFa: گرفتن و برداشتن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: took.

vocabulary.definition: To produce words on paper or a screen — past form: wrote
examples: He wrote an email last night.
vocabulary.explanationFa: نوشتن؛ گذشته‌اش بی‌قاعده است: wrote.
